intro: SNAP is the Symbiosis National Aptitude Test, the common entrance for MBA programmes at Symbiosis International (Deemed University). This page lists MBA colleges accepting SNAP 2026 from our records.
We currently link {{count}} programme options at {{colleges}} colleges to SNAP. Almost all of them are Symbiosis institutes, most of them in Pune.
SIU's official SNAP 2026 bulletin says registration closes on 25 November 2026, with computer-based tests on 13, 19 and 26 December 2026, and results on 12 January 2027.
listLead: The cards are Symbiosis institutes first, led by SIBM Pune. Read the programme name on each card; a few fee figures in our file look like a single component rather than the full two-year MBA fee.
snapshot: Nine of the {{colleges}} colleges are in Maharashtra, almost all in Pune, with one SIBM campus each in Bangalore and Hyderabad. That is a tight, institute-group list rather than a nationwide mix.

For colleges with a recorded average package, the median is {{pkgMedian}}, in a range from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}. These are historical records and should be checked in the latest official placement report.
SIBM Pune is 11th in the NIRF 2025 Management ranking, which is useful context when you compare top MBA / PGDM colleges in India 2026 that take SNAP.
firstCollegesLead: SIBM Pune's official 2026–28 notice lists academic fees of ₹6,55,000 in each of four instalments, or ₹26.20 lakh over two years, before hostel and mess. Our card now shows that official two-year academic total of ₹26.20 lakh, before hostel and mess.
Some other Symbiosis cards in our file show fees of ₹15,000 to ₹35,000, or a postgraduate diploma rather than the MBA. Treat those as data gaps and use the official institute fee page.

sections.heading: Official SNAP 2026 dates and eligibility
paragraphs: A candidate who wants an MBA at any SIU institute must take the SNAP computer-based test. You may book more than one of the three test dates; SIU will announce how multiple attempts are treated in its bulletin.

For the general MBA at SIBM Pune, SCMHRD and the other SIBM campuses, the official rule is a graduate degree with at least 50% marks, or 45% for SC and ST candidates. Some specialised programmes add extra subject or work-experience rules.
bullets: Registration and payment close on 25 November 2026, as per the official SNAP 2026 bulletin.
Tests are on 13, 19 and 26 December 2026, each 60 minutes, in computer-based mode.
Results are scheduled for 12 January 2027. After that, each institute runs its own GE-PI or similar shortlist.

compare.heading: How to shortlist MBA colleges accepting SNAP 2026
paragraphs: You are usually choosing among Symbiosis institutes, not among unrelated private universities. Compare the programme, campus and official fee, not only the SNAP score.
bullets: The exact MBA you want, because SCMHRD, SIIB, SCIT, SIDTM and others have specialised programmes with extra eligibility.
The official two-year fee notice, not a low figure on our card that may be a deposit or a single component.
NIRF and placement year. SIBM Pune is rank 11 in NIRF 2025.
Whether you will sit one, two or three SNAP attempts, and how the institute uses the score.

faqs.question: How many MBA colleges accept SNAP in this list?
faqs.answer: Our records link {{count}} programme options at {{colleges}} colleges to SNAP, almost all of them Symbiosis institutes. {{published}} of those colleges have a published profile.

faqs.question: When is SNAP 2026 being held?
faqs.answer: The official SNAP 2026 bulletin lists computer-based tests on 13, 19 and 26 December 2026. Registration closes on 25 November 2026, and results are scheduled for 12 January 2027.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for SNAP MBA programmes?
faqs.answer: The official SNAP site asks for a graduate degree from a recognised university, with at least 50% marks, or 45% for SC and ST candidates. Some specialised programmes add further academic or work-experience rules.

faqs.question: What is the fee at SIBM Pune?
faqs.answer: The official 2026–28 MBA fee notice lists academic fees of ₹6,55,000 in each of four instalments, which is ₹26.20 lakh over two years, before hostel and mess. Our card now shows that official two-year academic total of ₹26.20 lakh, before hostel and mess.

faqs.question: Are the placement figures guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No. For colleges with a recorded average package, the median is {{pkgMedian}}, from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}. Check the institute's latest official placement report, and note the year of each figure.
